name: @taste-and-see/nest-bullmq-scheduler
description: Shared in-service BullMQ repeatable-sweep scheduler for the Taste & See platform. `BullMqSchedulerModule.forRoot({ serviceName, environment, redisUrl })` owns the REDIS_URL decomposition and the CLAUDE.md §3.7 key prefix; `BullMqSchedulerService.schedule({ queueName, intervalMs, processor })` upserts one repeatable job scheduler cluster-wide and tears the queue + worker down on application shutdown. Extracted at the third copy of a skeleton that was verbatim in service-identity's rbac-revoker (TS-293) and service-booking's anomaly sweep (TS-308a/c). TS-308a-followup-1.
